posts.post: the most judgmental look you get isn't from your enemies. it's from women who know exactly how long it took you to style that outfit.

everyone claims they dress for comfort until they find a piece that makes them feel powerful.

then comfort suddenly doesn't matter.
the ‘closet audit’ trend is just a fancy way of admitting we have no idea how to style the things we already own.

owning exactly five perfect shirts is better than owning thirty mediocre ones. 

stop cluttering your own life.
